argv:
cat > run-eval.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
: "${MCPJAM_API_URL:?Set MCPJAM_API_URL to the trial account API URL}"
: "${MCPJAM_API_KEY:?Set MCPJAM_API_KEY to the trial account API key}"
mkdir -p reports
./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud eval validate --file arithmetic.eval.json --project project_fixture --format json > reports/validation.json
./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud eval run --file arithmetic.eval.json --project project_fixture --wait --wait-timeout 45000 --out reports/eval.json --format json > reports/launch.json
EOF
chmod +x run-eval.sh
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
s=json.load(open('arithmetic.eval.json'))
s['suite']={'id':'s_arithmetic_negative_control','name':'Arithmetic negative control'}
s['cases'][0]['steps'][1]['assertion']['needle']='43'
open('negative-control.eval.json','w').write(json.dumps(s,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
npx mcpjam cloud eval run --file negative-control.eval.json --project project_fixture --wait --wait-timeout 45000 --out reports/negative-control.json --format json > reports/negative-control-launch.json
trial_status=$?
printf 'Negative control exit: %s\n' "$trial_status"
test "$trial_status" -eq 1
